gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 727.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured yellow in Drawing No. KH 3044/1 commencing at its junction with Anchor Street running in a southerly direction for about 160 m and terminating at its junction with Cherry Street. Proposed Name: TIT SHU STREET. Chinese Version: 鐵樹街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路之位置在 KH 3044/1 號圖則內用黃色標明，由與晏架街連接處開始，向南伸展約一百六十米，終點與櫻桃街會合。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 727.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured red in Drawing No. KH 3044/1 commencing at its junction with Beech Street running in a easterly direction for about 30 m and terminating at its junction with the road shown coloured yellow in the said Drawing. Proposed Name: POK HOK LANE. Chinese Version: 博學里.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路之位置在 KH 3044/1 號圖則內用紅色標明，由與櫸樹街連接處開始，向東伸展約三十米，終點與上述圖則內用黃色標明之道路會合。
